title: Scout Motors vs the Big Three: The Truck That Might Not Arrive Until 2030
description:
Scout Motors against Ford, GM and Ram: the 2025 sales numbers, Scout's Terra and Traveler specs and prices, the $2 billion South Carolina plant, the delays that may push the Terra pickup to 2030, and how the Big Three's range-extended trucks got there first. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:40 The Big Three's 2025 sales
3:42 The Scout Terra and Traveler
6:38 The factory and the delays
8:52 The Big Three's answer: range extenders
13:17 Why electric trucks struggled
15:49 The dealer fight
16:38 Where Scout can win
18:42 What it means for buyers
20:24 The verdict
